answers.core:
Yes, this should be core because:

It's a consistency improvement to an existing core API
It can't be properly implemented as an add-on since it requires modifying the AStarGrid2D class
It would maintain consistency with Godot's general approach to handling 2D coordinates
It affects a core class that's fundamental to many games' navigation systems
The change is small but would improve API consistency and usability across all projects using AStarGrid2D
answers.workaround: While it can be worked around by manually splitting Vector2i into components, this enhancement would be used frequently in any project using AStarGrid2D for navigation or grid-based gameplay. The current workaround makes code less readable and more error-prone, especially in loops where position checking is frequent.

title: API Inconsistency in AStarGrid2D: Mixed Parameter Types for Position Checking
